استزمرا (form X)
# اِسْتَزْمَرَا (istazmarā) /is.taz.ma.raː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَزْمَرَ (istazmara)
# اِسْتَزْمِرَا (istazmirā) /is.taz.mi.raː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَزْمَرَ (istazmara)
